text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thanks as always for the fan signs! I 
always look forward to seeing what message 
you'll write next!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Because Royce-chan gives fan service that 
matches the messages! That makes me so 
super happy~~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, look forward to the next live show, 
okay?♪ Happy Valentine's♡

A day off before Valentine's. Royce and 
Royce was holding a small fan meeting in 
front of a shop.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You came all the way from Kansai?! I'm so 
happy! Your letters always give me so much 
encouragement!

text_block_list.name: Royce's Fan B
text_block_list.text:
! M-Me too! To the hardworking 
Royce-chan...! Seeing your run in the 
Kikuka Sho in person was amazing!

The line of fans never broke right until 
time ran out, making the event a massive 
success with high satisfaction.
choice_data_list: That fan meet will lead to the next one!

That fan meet will lead us nicely into 
what's next!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Seeing the happy looks on everyone's 
faces... Hehehe, it turned out to be a 
wonderful Valentine's event!
choice_data_list: 次に繋がるファンミになったな！
次に繋がるファンミになったね！
choice_data_list_en: That fan meeting will definitely lead into our next steps!
That fan meeting will really lead into our next steps!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—That is precisely why next year's event 
must surpass this year's satisfaction, or 
it won't become a memorable event.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We'll probably have more fans next year, 
too... I need to start thinking about what 
we should do.
choice_data_list: Plans for next year already?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
We also have to book a venue, so we need 
to move fast! We need rehearsals too.
choice_data_list: もう来年の計画！？
choice_data_list_en: Plans for next year already?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I plan to make it an interactive 
experience. Rather than just getting 
chocolate and being done with it, 
experiencing something together will leave 
a much stronger memory, don't you think?
choice_data_list: リハーサル？なんで？
choice_data_list_en: A rehearsal? Why?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... I'll think of something by 
Valentine's. So, can I practice on you, 
Trainer?
choice_data_list: O-Okay, got it

text_block_list.text:
Rehearsing for next year's Valentine's Day 
on this year's Valentine's Day. Things 
have gotten rather complicated—
choice_data_list: わ、わかった
choice_data_list_en: A-All right.

text_block_list.text:
On the day of Valentine's, upon entering 
the Trainer's office—
An envelope had been placed on the desk.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
To Trainer-san: I made this Valentine's 
project into a treasure hunt!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Use the hints on the message card to 
search for the treasure, okay?♪

Written on the message card was: 'The 
school newspaper's classmate special 
feature. The Umamusume paired with me on 
that page.'
choice_data_list:
A special feature in the school newspaper, 
huh...

text_block_list.text:
That was just before her debut. When 
interviewed by the school newspaper, she 
gave them advice on their page layout.
choice_data_list: 校内新聞の特集っていうと……
choice_data_list_en: Speaking of the school paper's special feature...

text_block_list.text:
I was thoroughly impressed by how 
exceptional her research and analytical 
skills regarding the academy students 
were.
choice_data_list:
(I remember feeling so rushed, thinking I 
had to catch up to Royce...)

text_block_list.text:
She suggested Sakura Chitose O as her 
opponent, saying the two of them would 
create a great contrast between stillness 
and motion.
choice_data_list: （ロイスに追いつかなきゃと焦ってたっけ）
choice_data_list_en: (I was in such a rush, thinking I had to catch up to Royce, wasn't I?)

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text: "Oh my... Royce-san's Trainer...?"
choice_data_list: Um, did Royce leave anything with you?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chitose O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes... over here, correct? Hohoho... 
what a delightful little game this seems 
to be.
choice_data_list: あの、ロイスから何か預かってないかな
choice_data_list_en: Um, did Royce leave anything with you?

text_block_list.text:
The hint written on the card was "The 
Umamusume who ate soft serve ice cream 
with me during last year's summer training 
camp."
choice_data_list: ありがとう！
choice_data_list_en: Thanks!

text_block_list.text:
"During the summer training camp of the 
Classic Year, we built the foundation of 
our youth with BNW."

"To get closer with BNW, I proposed 
high-altitude training and set up the 
environment, which she utilized 
brilliantly."
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if I was able to help back then, 
even a little...)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's the thing from Royce, right! 
Hold on a second.
choice_data_list: （あの時……少しは力になれたのかな）
choice_data_list_en: (Back then...I wonder if I was of any help.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Yes, here you go!
Now then, the next clue is—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, I'm so curious what's written 
there... Ah, no, I know I shouldn't look!
choice_data_list: ...It's probably fine to look.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure? ...What's this? A riddle? 
'The place where the "strongest Umamusume" 
stand side by side'...?"
choice_data_list: ……たぶん、見ても大丈夫だよ
choice_data_list_en: ...I think it's okay to look.

text_block_list.text:
The hints Royce and Royce left behind were 
based on experiences they had shared 
together.
choice_data_list: I see... A trip down memory lane, then.

text_block_list.text:
Tracing back through memorable places and 
people while hunting for treasure. It was 
also a way to look back on the time spent 
with her.
choice_data_list: なるほど……思い出巡りか
choice_data_list_en: I see... A trip down memory lane, huh?

text_block_list.text:
This will undoubtedly deepen your feelings 
for her and make for an even more 
unforgettable experience.
choice_data_list:
(I've started to be able to read her 
intentions.)

text_block_list.text:
Tracing back through my memories with her, 
I could truly feel the deepening of our 
bond.
choice_data_list: （彼女の意図も読めるようになってきた）
choice_data_list_en: (I've started to be able to read her intentions.)

text_block_list.text:
—The hint is: "A place where the 
'Strongest Umamusume' stand side by side."
choice_data_list: そして、次の場所へと向かう――
choice_data_list_en: And so, off to the next destination—

text_block_list.text:
The day her debut was decided, we visited 
this place together. It is our starting 
point, where we confirmed our goal to 
become 'the strongest.'

What comes to mind is the memory of her, 
eyes sparkling as she talked about the 
"strongest Umamusume"—
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if she's somewhere inside the 
building...)

text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, correct♪ You found your way here 
properly, didn't you?
choice_data_list: （館内のどこかにいるのかな……）
choice_data_list_en: (I wonder if she's somewhere in the building...)

text_block_list.text:
Just as I thought I heard her voice, my 
vision was suddenly plunged into darkness.
choice_data_list_en: !? Royce...!?

text_block_list.text:
Shh...! Inside the hall, stay quiet. Now, 
just close your eyes—

A breathy voice tickles my ear. As I close 
my eyes, the warmth on my eyelids pulls 
away.

—Instead, a small weight dropped softly 
into my coat pocket.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: It's my treasured reward.

As the voice faded away, I slowly opened 
my eyes.
—However, she was nowhere to be found...
choice_data_list: Ah, Pocket...

text_block_list.text:
Reaching inside, my fingertips brush 
against an angular box. Through the chic 
wrapping paper, the faint, mellow aroma of 
cacao wafts up.
choice_data_list: あ、ポケット……
choice_data_list_en: Ah, Pocket...

text_block_list.text:
—The next morning. I spot Royce and Royce 
and call out to her.
choice_data_list: Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer. Good morning. Did you enjoy 
the treasure hunt yesterday?
choice_data_list: ロイス！
choice_data_list_en: Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Right?! Fufu, I was pretty confident in 
it~♪
choice_data_list: あ……うん。思い出巡りはいい案だと思う
choice_data_list_en: Ah... Yeah. I think taking a trip down memory lane is a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, next year's event will definitely 
be a treasure hunt!
choice_data_list: Um, about yesterday's chocolate...

text_block_list.text:
The chocolate that was in my pocket 
yesterday. In case it was meant for a 
rehearsal, I brought it along just as it 
was.
choice_data_list: えっと、昨日のチョコって……
choice_data_list_en: Um, about yesterday's chocolate...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's for you, Trainer. As a token of 
my daily appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—It's a chocolate orange. Made with 
high-cacao chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Pairing it with orange softens the 
bitterness, making it delicious to eat. I 
tasted it myself, so I can guarantee the 
flavor.
choice_data_list: Thank you, I'll gladly have some!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you're very welcome♪
choice_data_list: ありがとう、いただくよ！
choice_data_list_en: Thanks, I'll have some!

text_block_list.text:
Since she wasn't around anymore, I spent 
all of last night worrying about whether 
it was all right for me to accept the 
chocolates.
choice_data_list: でも、それなら昨日はなぜ先に帰ったんだ？
でも、それなら昨日はなぜ先に帰ったの？
choice_data_list_en: Still, why did you go home early yesterday then?
Still, why did you go home early yesterday then?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, wasn't that delightfully 
mysterious?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Who were these leftover chocolates meant 
for? Why did they leave just the chocolate 
behind and walk away without saying a 
word?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Until you found the answer, you must have 
been thinking about me the e~ntire time.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“—That is what makes it a special 
experience. It must have left a strong 
impression on you, right?”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, playing with the dark might just 
work. I'll need to tweak how I hand over 
the chocolate, though—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I hope Valentine's Day with Royce became 
an unforgettable memory♪

Even her anguish was dancing in the palm 
of her hand. Completely manipulated by the 
scheme, she was left with unforgettable 
memories intertwined with raw emotion—

I thought she was behind me, so hearing 
her voice suddenly so close made me 
involuntarily—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "H-Hey! Why are you opening your eyes!"
choice_data_list:
S-Sorry! I sensed someone there and 
reacted without thinking...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*... If we make a scene, we'll cause 
trouble. Let's head outside."
choice_data_list: ご、ごめん！気配を感じて、思わず……！
choice_data_list_en: S-Sorry! I sensed someone and reacted before I knew it...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
So... how was your treasure hunting 
experience?
choice_data_list:
I think retracing our memories is a great 
idea!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Right? I'm so glad♪
choice_data_list: 思い出を辿るのはいい案だと思う！
choice_data_list_en: I think taking a trip down memory lane is a great idea!

text_block_list.text:
There are many impractical aspects to 
this, such as handing out chocolates to 
her countless fans.
choice_data_list: でも、最後の演出は色々問題がありそう
choice_data_list_en: Still, that finale seems like it might cause a few problems...

text_block_list.text:
I can't imagine she would fail to notice a 
problem of this degree, but...
choice_data_list:
Is there a reason you were so particular 
about that staging?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
choice_data_list: あの演出にこだわった理由でもあるの？
choice_data_list_en: Is there a reason you were so set on that staging?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I just hand over the chocolate like 
normal, it'll definitely get buried under 
all the others...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's why I thought really hard about 
what I could do to leave an impression...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I figured all I had to do was make your 
heart race!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Still... I guess I couldn't make your 
heart race, Trainer-san.
choice_data_list: N-No, my heart was definitely pounding!

text_block_list.text:
Being deprived of vision is truly 
unsettling. Not knowing what might happen 
certainly made my heart race.
choice_data_list: い、いや、ドキドキはしたよ！
choice_data_list_en: N-No, my heart was definitely pounding!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I wonder if a pitch-black staging 
would work? I really want to leave an 
impression with an impactful experience.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Revealing that 'I just wanted everyone's 
hearts to race!' might also be good to 
show your earnestness!"
choice_data_list: (Wait, that was part of the drill too?!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
By the way, about that chocolate wrapping. 
Did you notice anything about it?
choice_data_list: （って、さっきのも演習か！）
choice_data_list_en: (Wait, that was a drill too!?)

text_block_list.text:
Urged on, I check it. The wrapping paper 
is plain, with no shop logo or anything of 
the sort. Which means, it's not a 
store-bought product, but—
choice_data_list: Huh? Don't tell me, it's handmade!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ah...! Royce is so happy you noticed!
choice_data_list: えっ？まさか、手作り！？
choice_data_list_en: Huh? No way, homemade!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It was tough making them from scratch, but 
I made them while looking back on all my 
memories with you, Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Chocolates filled with soft-serve ice 
cream-flavored cream, and chocolates 
filled with plum jam.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the plum jam chocolate is inspired 
by medicinal cuisine, you see.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Not only will I reflect on our memories, 
I'll also infuse those memories into the 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"And then follow it up with a combo line 
like, 'I made this while looking back on 
our memories!'"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to leave an impression 
stronger than any chocolate, no doubt 
about it!
choice_data_list: (Huh? No, no way, isn't that impossible?)

text_block_list.text:
It's impossible to make handmade chocolate 
for every single fan. In that case, 
practicing on the premise of making 
handmade chocolate seems kinda pointless 
to begin with—
choice_data_list: （え？いやいや、それは不可能じゃ？）
choice_data_list_en: (Wait, no way... Isn't that impossible?)

text_block_list.text:
Wait, are these really homemade 
chocolates? If they're store-bought, 
that's impossible for a Memory Link—
choice_data_list: （じゃあ、手作りチョコは何のために？）
choice_data_list_en: (Then what was the handmade chocolate for...?)

text_block_list.text:
I can't read the truth behind her words at 
all...!
choice_data_list: （これ、どこまでが演習なんだ！？）
（これ、どこまでが演習なの！？）
choice_data_list_en: (Just how much of this is part of the drill...?!)
(How much of this is part of the drill...?!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... What a great expression♪ You're 
confused, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if my self-producing this year 
was a smashing success.
choice_data_list: Huh...?

text_block_list.text:
When we brought them home and opened them 
up, we found chocolates flavored like soft 
serve and plum jam—
choice_data_list_en: Huh...?

text_block_list.text:
Although the chocolate turned out to be 
handmade, her true intentions remained 
utterly perplexing.

—However, one thing was certain: it was a 
Valentine's Day no one would ever forget.
